answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the beacon of a task receipt, and the bridge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
